purpose: Teach: 不全/悪循環/転移/結核/抗生/天文学/否認/思い知らさ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の機能不全、本気で、当社、絶対、リーダーシップ、見せていけ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: The dysfunction in this industry — our company must show absolute leadership. I'm serious. You understand me?
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Measured but intense. Each point lands with deliberate weight. No room for misunderstanding. The tone of someone who has seen failure and won't accept it from his team.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の悪循環、当社、本気で、断ち切る覚悟、社員、皆、持っております、絶対、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We are committed to breaking the industry's vicious cycle. Our entire team is ready, sir. Absolutely.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Respectful without flatness. Each commitment lands firmly. Slight pause before 'absolutely' — showing he means it, not just echoing his boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人材の海外転移、当社にも、影響、絶対、出てきている、対策、本気で、急務だぞ、本当に、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Talent is migrating overseas — it's affecting us too. We need a counter-strategy now. This is urgent.
lines.style: Direct and forceful. Clipped pace on key phrases. The frustration of a boss naming a real threat. Leans forward slightly. Not angry, but brooking no delays.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。結核などの感染症、社員の健康管理、本気で、徹底しております、絶対、本当に、感謝。
lines.en: Understood. We're maintaining strict health protocols for our staff — including infectious disease prevention. You can count on us.
lines.style: Professional, reassuring cadence. Shows he's thought this through. Slight emphasis on 'strict' and 'count on us' — demonstrating competence without overselling. Even-keeled.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 抗生物質を扱う事業、当社、本気で、参入の可能性、検討中だ、本気で、頼んだぞ、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: We're exploring entry into the antibiotic business sector right now. I want that contingency ready. Make it happen.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. States the priority clearly. Slight weight on 'I want' — not a suggestion, a directive. Trusts his team to execute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。天文学的な、データ量、当社のシステム、本気で、処理可能です、絶対、本気で、お任せください。
lines.en: Absolutely, sir. Our systems can handle the volume — even at astronomical scale. We're ready to take this on.
lines.style: Confident, almost calm. Shows technical assurance without boasting. Slight lift at 'absolutely' — a small verbal nod of professional pride. Clean, decisive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 責任を、否認する文化、当社、絶対、許さない方針、社員、徹底させろ、本気で、絶対、頼んだぞ、本当に。
lines.en: A culture of denying responsibility has no place here. I want that eradicated from this company. Make sure every person understands.
lines.style: Cold, uncompromising. The words themselves carry the weight. Slower pace — each phrase hits separately. The voice of someone drawing a hard line that won't move.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の厳しさ、本気で、毎日、思い知らされております、絶対、本気で、頑張ってまいります、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Every day I feel the pressure of this industry. We will meet that challenge. We won't let you down.
lines.style: Quiet strength underneath. Not bravado. A younger man showing he's made of stronger stuff than his words suggest. Ends with steady resolve — a promise, not a plea.
